review.notes: Sentence-level diff of all 46 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown, plus rendered visual checks of pages 5, 6, 28 (300 dpi table row crop), 33 and 38 (300 dpi caption crop). No code fences exist in the source, so no fence-balance defect; 24 image embeds match the 24 registered crops; references [1]-[13] and all table values (Tables 1-17) match the source. Confirmed repairs are two dropped footnote/small-print blocks and one spurious heading. The PDF itself prints "13.82 %" (p.28) and the duplicated "of of" (p.38 caption), so the OCR transcription of those spots is faithful and was left unchanged. The 'Combined Pass Rate:' bullet list prints gpt-5.2-codex while Table 15 has no such column; the source itself is inconsistent and both readings were kept.
